name: Keys Palms Luxury RV Resort
note: Small gated resort with 30 sites; it books by phone only, since the website's reservation form is just an information request. No tents or pop-ups, and travel trailers and fifth wheels go only on the pull-through and back-in sites. --Claude
inclusion_evidence: Operator site keyspalmsrvresort.com read 2026-10-30: 30 numbered RV sites with full hookups on its site plan, welcomes motorhomes, fifth wheels and travel trailers, posts daily rates per site on a Nov 2025-Apr 2027 rate sheet, phone 305-440-2832; Campendium 2025-01-01 review of a one-night stop in a 38-ft Class A, and a 32-ft Class C stayed in 2020; Google Maps open with a phone, 4.7/460; not in Good Sam's directory as a condo park, no homes or lots for sale (MHVillage lists 0) -> real transient RV resort; price gate lifted: Florida Keys zone (AWH 2026-10-30, gateways.py)
waterfront_evidence: 2026-10-30: the operator's site plan (keyspalmsrvresort.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/03/Keys-Palms-Property-Map.pdf) puts pull-in sites 12-13 at the kayak launch and the sand strip on Florida Bay, with sites 8-11 ending at the pool deck on the shore. The satellite (Esri, sat.py at 25.14715,-80.39600, 120 m frame, rendered) shows the NW row of RV pads backing onto an open strip of grass and scattered palms plus the resort's seawall walkway, about 10 m from pad end to the water. That is the campground's own frontage, with no road, lot or treeline between, so it is an open apron within the distance bound. The rest of the loop is set back behind those rows, and Florida Bay is open salt water.
fees_source: https://keyspalmsrvresort.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/11/Keys-Palms-RV-rates-winter-2025-thru-2027-Printable-version.pdf (version 11/13/2025, read 2026-10-30): daily rate by site, before county/state tax, any rig. Winter Nov 1 2026-Apr 30 2027 (in season) runs from $170 (sites 1-2, 30) to $230 (sites 7-14). Summer May 1-Oct 31 2026 runs from $150 to $195. The sheet lists no resort or grounds fee. Bookings are taken by phone, so no engine quote was run.
flags: No online booking engine: the reservations page is an information-request form, and bookings are 'made with a park representative' with a deposit. The cancellation fee is $35 more than 8 days out and $200 inside 8 days.
Cheapest in-season (winter) night is $170 before tax; summer from $150.
No minimum stay is published anywhere (rate sheet, rules page, reviews), and a 2025 reviewer stayed one night.
Reviews mention tight sites for big rigs, which doesn't matter for a 23-ft Class C.
